name: SITA OS
subtitle: Sovereign AI Operating System
shortDescription: Your sovereign AI operating system. Calm intelligence, every day.
description:
SITA OS is a premium, dark-first AI operating system that turns scattered work, money, and life signals into a calm, advised flow.

Key capabilities:
• Boardroom — strategic council that reviews your operating reality
• Business — pipeline, accounts, and outcomes in one dignified workspace
• Money — reserves, runway, and tax posture explained in plain language
• Concierge — 24/7 advisor presence across every surface
• Files — encrypted vault with semantic search and proof-grade AI summaries

Designed for owner-operators, founders, and family principals who deserve calm, not noise.
